name: Silver Bolts keeps its native 15% on the damage calculation of all three bolts (#3342)
contract: Silver Bolts 804026 reads 'Damage dealt by Heartseeking Bolt, Shadowblast, and Damnation is increased by $s1%, doubled against Undead or Demons or enemies affected by Shadow Trap' with $s1 = 15; mentor D-163 reads 'doubled' as 1.30. Effect 2 is a SPELLMOD_DAMAGE +15% whose DBC class mask (0x10000, 0x800, 0) covers Damnation and Heartseeking Bolt; ApplyContracts (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp) adds Shadowblast's word 2 bit 0x10 while the DBC mask is unchanged. Effect 0 (aura 112, selector 20014, MiscValueB 36 = Demon 4 | Undead 32, class mask (0x10000, 0x800, 0x10)) is a dummy aura read by the class hit hook (SilverBoltsDoubledShare, AscensionWitchHunterAbilities.cpp, Witch Hunter ADR 0010), which multiplies a real hit by (100 + 15 + 15) / (100 + 15) once on an Undead, Demon or Shadow Trapped 681177 target. That hook runs in OnSpellCalculatedTarget, which the deterministic melee_spell_damage_done and melee_spell_damage_done_scripted metrics do not reach, so this scenario asserts the native 1.15 on every target for Heartseeking Bolt 805754, Damnation 520062 and Shadowblast 680269, and that no other factor (the former SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS conversion or the removed Shadow Trap UnitScript) adds to it. The doubled 1.30 on real hits is measured by the conformance entries '804026 behaviour_hit_ratio <spell>_<target>' (apps/coa-gameplay-test/conformance/classes/witch_hunter.json). Creature types come from data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql: 201 Brittlebones Skeleton type 6 (Undead), 49 Lesser Succubus type 3 (Demon), 36 Harvest Golem type 9 (Mechanical).
